title: Access Control
subtitle: Hotlink protection and IP-based allow/deny list.

hotlink.title: Hotlink Protection
hotlink.desc: Your images (jpg, png, gif, webp, svg…) cannot be shown via direct links (hotlinking) from other sites; only requests from your own domain and the addresses you allow below can access the images.

ip.title: IP Allow/Deny List
ip.desc: Restrict access to this domain to specific IP addresses, or block malicious IPs.
ip.empty_allow: No rules yet — while the list is empty, this mode is considered disabled (the site won't be locked out).
